answer: Think of it as a work history that has to stay warm. Each identity earns credit only after three epochs of different submissions, and that credit expires if it misses two epochs in a row, so you cannot park a thousand accounts and let them age like a pearl in a drawer. Auditors rotate, so no group can review its own row of accounts, and the canyon between a real history and a fresh one takes weeks to cross. The farm pays rent the whole way and still arrives at the same wharf as everyone else.
